{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u084/system/state/workspace/programs/task-313d3ef7.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the full-width horizontal divider.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != grid[0][0])
    div_color = grid[divider][0]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # The moving object is the non-background, non-divider color.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg, div_color)}
    obj_color = next(iter(colors))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == obj_color]
    min_r = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    max_r = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    min_c = min(c for _, c in cells)
    max_c = max(c for _, c in cells)
    shape = {(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in cells}
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    out[divider] = list(grid[divider])
    if max_r < divider:
        new_min_r = divider - 1 - (max_r - min_r)
        trail_r = new_min_r - 1
    else:
        new_min_r = divider + 1
        trail_r = new_min_r + (max_r - min_r) + 1
    for dr, dc in shape:
        out[new_min_r + dr][min_c + dc] = obj_color
    if 0 <= trail_r < h:
        out[trail_r] = [8] * w
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
